_comment: F4a compact core-context variant (scripts/ai/build_core_context.py --compact). Facts only, no logic: which contract sections and which value-reference paths a one-shot external AI authoring simple-crud / workflow-roles / integration-report apps does not need. The full bundle is untouched; the compact one is written beside it as bundle-compact.json. Measure with run_bench.py --knowledge-file before adopting. DETAIL LEVELS (npdev ai context --detail): `full` = no policy; `standard` = the top-level keys of this file (what --compact always was); `lean` = the object under `lean`, for a one-shot simple-crud app. A level ships only if run_bench.py --knowledge-file shows it passes its tier as often as `full`.
